content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Research Scientist II (Medical), 1 for Project Research Scientist I (Medical), and 3 for Project Technical Support III.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist II (Medical): MBBS / BVSc / BDS with three years' post qualification experience OR MBBS / BVSc / BDS + Post Graduate Degree (MD/ MVSc/ MDS/ MPH) or any equivalent degree, including integrated PG degrees OR MBBS/ BVSc/ BDS with PhD. Desirable: Candidates with at least one year experience in community-based health research projects will be preferred. Project Research Scientist I (Medical): MBBS/ BVSc/ BDS or equivalent. Desirable: Candidates with one year experience in community-based health research projects OR candidates with MPH degree will be preferred. Project Technical Support III: Three years graduate in relevant subject/ field (Medical Social work (Community development/ Social Welfare/ Medical) or B.Sc. (Community Health or Life Sciences)) + Three years' experience (in the community-based research) OR Post Graduate degree in relevant subject/ field (Medical social work/ MPH). Desirable: Candidates with at least one year experience in community-based health research projects OR candidates with MPH degree will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 40 years for all posts. Age relaxation: SC/ ST up to 5 years, OBC up to 3 years. Age relaxation up to 5 years for deserving candidates with experience in Government Research Organization. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Nagpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the AIIMS Nagpur recruitment is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Research Scientist II (Medical) posts?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist II (Medical) post. However, the total number of vacancies across all advertised posts is 5.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Technical Support III?
faq.answer: For Project Technical Support III, candidates need a three-year graduate degree in relevant fields like Medical Social Work or B.Sc. (Community Health or Life Sciences) with three years of experience, or a Post Graduate degree in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Nagpur recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for Project Research Scientist I (Medical)?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Research Scientist I (Medical) is Rs. 67,000/- per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA), totaling Rs. 80,400/-.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection methods for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts includes a Written Test, followed by an Interview, and finally Document Verification for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates with a PhD apply for Project Research Scientist II (Medical)?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with an MBBS/BVSc/BDS degree along with a PhD are eligible to apply for the Project Research Scientist II (Medical) position.

faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' description. It is crucial to read this document thoroughly.
